name: Tempest Therapeutics, Inc.

marketCap.note: A Benzinga snapshot dated 2026-09-27 showed a reasonably close $13.60M, lending some support to this figure, though the underlying share count used by each source is inconsistent - see conflicts.

sharesOutstanding.note: Could not reconcile conflicting figures: TipRanks 4,440,161 (likely stale, possibly pre-dating or otherwise inconsistent with the 2025-04-08 1-for-13 reverse split); Equibles 14,806,997; Google Finance 15.98M; and an implied ~19.7M backed out of the Trade-Ideas market cap/price snapshot (2026-10-16). None could be confirmed against the 10-Q cover page because WebFetch to SEC.gov failed with DNS errors in this sandbox.

cash.note: Very low cash balance relative to typical clinical-stage biotech burn rates - consistent with the company's recent small private placements/warrant inducements and implies likely near-term need for additional financing or dilution.

pe.note: negative earnings; pre-revenue clinical-stage biotech, no earnings estimate basis

eps.note: Not located in sandbox search; only financing-related figures (private placement/warrant proceeds) were found, not the income statement EPS line.

growth.note: Pre-revenue biotech. March 2026 private placement of common stock and warrants raised net proceeds of $1.7M; a Q2 2026 warrant inducement raised a further $1.7M (one secondary source says $2M - see conflicts). Cash on hand had fallen to approx. $779K by 2026-10-16, suggesting continued reliance on small, dilutive financings.

nextEarnings.note: Yahoo Finance lists 2026-11-05 as the next earnings date, but that page's other data (price/market cap) was from a late-August 2026 snapshot, so the date itself should be treated as an estimate, not company-confirmed.

price.source: Trade-Ideas (carried forward from prior pass; down ~78% YTD, ~48% over the trailing month per the same source)

catalysts.headline: Announced an exclusive option to license Hebei Senlang Biotechnology's CD7-targeted lentiviral in-vivo CAR-T platform (led by a Phase 1 BCMA/GPRC5D dual-targeting candidate for multiple myeloma), paired with a ~$2.5M warrant-based private placement

Tempest and Hebei Senlang Biotechnology announce a development collaboration; first step is an investigator-initiated trial (IIT) in China of Tempest's CD7-targeted in vivo CAR-T candidate TPST-4003 in approx. 10 patients with myasthenia gravis or multiple sclerosis, with first dosing expected Q4 2026 and initial clinical data guided for H1 2027

Tempest Q2 2026 results disclose a Q2 2026 warrant inducement raising approx. $1.7M (one secondary source states $2M), on top of a March 2026 private placement of common stock and warrants that raised net proceeds of $1.7M
catalysts.impact: Small dilutive financings; cash position remained thin through Q3 2026 (approx. $779K by 2026-10-16 per Trade-Ideas)

conflicts: The 2025-04-08 reverse split is now confirmed at an exact 1-for-13 ratio (SEC Form 8-K; stockholders authorized a 1-for-2 to 1-for-15 range on 2024-12-03, and the Board selected 1-for-13), which narrows but does not resolve the shares-outstanding confusion: sources dated April-September 2026 show a rising progression (~13.5M in early April, ~14.3-14.8M by mid-2026, ~15.98M by September, an implied ~19.7M by Oct 16 per the on-file Trade-Ideas-derived figure) that may reflect genuine share-count growth from the company's repeated small dilutive financings rather than pure data disagreement. A separate TipRanks figure of 4,440,161 shares is inconsistent with all of these and is likely stale or erroneous. Shares outstanding is left null given no single current authoritative figure.
notes: No new dated catalysts found beyond the 2026-09-16 Senlang CD7 CAR-T licensing option and 2026-08-13 Q2 2026 earnings/financing items already on file. The 2025-04-08 1-for-13 reverse-split ratio is now independently confirmed via SEC 8-K (prior pass had the date but not a fully verified ratio/authorization trail). Market cap, cash, and debt figures already on file ($12.5M, $779K, $7.6K respectively, all as of 2026-10-16) are unchanged; no newer snapshot located this session.
